project_type: Two separate React (Vite) + React Router frontends; Express backend (read-only)
build_system: Vite (npm run build) for each frontend independently
build_command: npm run build (run in each frontend root: salebysale-users-frontend and salebysale-admin-frontend)
test_command: N/A (no test framework; manual E2E verification required)
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm run build` in /Users/mac/freeLancing/salebysale/salebysale-users-frontend → must exit code 0, dist/ created. 2. Run `npm run build` in /Users/mac/freeLancing/salebysale/salebysale-admin-frontend → must exit code 0, dist/ created. 3. Manual E2E test: buyer searches (no supplier name visible) → admin arranges courier (wholesaler name visible) → supplier packs with IMEI → rider delivers with OTP → buyer sees delivered status (still no supplier name).
environment_constraints: Backend at http://localhost:5050 is read-only (DO NOT MODIFY). Users-frontend dev port 5173, admin-frontend dev port 5174 (vite.config.js already proxies all /auth, /catalog, /inventory, /supplier, /orders, /shipments, /admin, /riders routes to backend). Both frontends must run independently; no cross-imports allowed.
contribution_requirements: Privacy non-negotiable: buyer UI must NEVER render supplier names/identities (only 'SELL BY SELL verified stock' label). Admin UI MUST show supplier + buyer names for orchestration. Backend sanitization already strips supplierId from buyer responses; frontend enforces by never rendering supplierId fields. IMEI encrypted by backend before storage; admin can decrypt via /admin/imei/:orderId. Supplier anonymity verified by: grep 'supplierId' in Buyer.jsx JSX → zero matches.
key_patterns: useAuth hook (auth.jsx) for user/business/login/logout; api(path, {method, body}) helper (api.js) for all fetch calls with auto token header; inr(n) for currency formatting; styles.css provides .card, .btn, .grid, .badge, .alert, .ok classes; App.jsx uses React Router with Guard component; Layout.jsx shows role-based side nav menus; all page components in src/pages/ (Buyer.jsx, Supplier.jsx, Rider.jsx, Admin.jsx, Login.jsx, Register.jsx, Layout.jsx, Landing.jsx); backend responses already sanitized for buyer role (sanitizeOrder strips supplierId in orders.js route).
directory_structure: salebysale-users-frontend/src/{auth.jsx, api.js, App.jsx, pages/{Buyer.jsx, Supplier.jsx, Rider.jsx, Admin.jsx, Login.jsx, Register.jsx, Layout.jsx, Landing.jsx}, styles.css, main.jsx}; salebysale-admin-frontend/src/ mirrors same structure; salebysale-backend/routes/ contains all API route files (read-only reference).
